why: ClubElo is European club football only (589 clubs), which left most of a friendlies slate unrated — measured, 63 of 399 fixtures. Son suggested this source; it closes exactly that gap.

access.robots_txt: contains a Sitemap line and NOTHING else — no Disallow, no AI-crawler block. Contrast footballdatabase.com, which names and disallows ClaudeBot and was ruled out rather than worked around.
access.shape: Quarto/htmlwidget: the ENTIRE table arrives in one 162KB GET as a single application/json blob. No pagination, no AJAX, no browser needed. Refresh cost is one request.
access.cadence: the source updates weekly, on Tuesdays

coverage.duplicate_rows: 31 byte-identical duplicate rows (tied ranks listed twice, e.g. '1. FC Union Berlin' at rank 100). Keying by stable id de-duplicates them; no data is lost.
coverage.stable_id_note: col 6 is a provider-stable id (e.g. 'nVp0wiqd'), which satisfies AGENTS.md's requirement for provider-stable identity over names.

PUBLISHED_METHOD.CRITICAL: 600, NOT ClubElo's 400. The method is an adaptation of FIFA's post-2018 ranking procedure, not classic Elo. The same rating gap therefore means a materially different thing in each system: dr=200 gives 0.6830 here vs 0.7597 under a 400 divisor. Mixing a rating from one provider with a rating from the other inside one expectation would be arithmetic without a referent, and neither publishes a conversion.
PUBLISHED_METHOD.W: win=1, draw=0.5, loss=0 — so this is an expected POINTS SHARE

AUTHORS_OWN_CAVEAT: Quoted, not paraphrased away: the ranking 'should thus not be deemed as a try to accurately rank club-level football around the world, but rather as an experiment on the effectiveness of the underlying method'. That is a weaker self-claim than ClubElo makes, and it travels with every number the module returns.

AMBIGUITY_HAZARD_FOUND.case: 'Al Sadd' matches TWO clubs: Al-Sadd SC (Qatar, 1350) and Al Sadd (Yemen, 1029) — a 321-point gap. Both normalise to 'al sadd' because 'sc' is a stop word.
AMBIGUITY_HAZARD_FOUND.why_that_is_lucky: the collision is DETECTABLE rather than silent. An exact-match-first implementation without the collision check would have confidently returned Yemen for a Qatari club playing Trabzonspor.
AMBIGUITY_HAZARD_FOUND.resolution: candidates are collected across BOTH containment directions; if they span more than one country the pair is refused as name_ambiguous unless the fixture's league country disambiguates. Same-country collisions (FC Tokyo vs Tokyo Verdy, CD Guadalajara vs Atlas Guadalajara) are resolved by preferring EXACT token identity over containment, which needs no guess.

COVERAGE_RESULT_on_the_399_fixture_slate.per_side_source_choice_REGRESSION: 50 rated (13%) — WORSE than ClubElo alone. Preferring worldclubratings per SIDE stranded 34 fixtures whose two clubs resolved in different providers, refused as sources_not_on_one_scale.
COVERAGE_RESULT_on_the_399_fixture_slate.note: the 306 unmapped are overwhelmingly reserve sides and lower divisions genuinely absent from both providers; each says so rather than showing a number.

reserve_side_guard: Reserve/youth/women's markers refuse ahead of every matching tier, in BOTH provider clients. Without it 'Mallorca II' matches 'Mallorca' by containment and publishes a senior club's rating about a reserve team — the Real Madrid vs Castilla hazard this repo warns about in three files. Proven by removing it: 7 reserve cases fail.
